---
title: "Welcome to the Cookbook"
lang: en
---

This site is a recipe book powered by [Gram](https://gram-lang.org), a simple
text format for writing recipes, and [Quarto](https://quarto.org). Every recipe
is a `.gram` file compiled into an interactive page when the site is built.

## How to follow a recipe

- **Quick overview** — at the top of each page, a table: the columns are the
  actions (Mix, Heat, Bake…), the rows list what goes into them (quantities
  scale automatically), and the right cell shows temperature and time. It's the
  whole recipe in one glance.
- **Full steps** — detailed step-by-step instructions with intermediate mixes
  and a timeline chart.
- **Cook mode** — click *Start cooking* on any recipe page to walk through
  steps hands-free; the current step stays centered while you work.

Use the **scale buttons** (½×–3×) on a recipe page to adjust portions; every
quantity, the overview table, and timings update instantly.

## Where to go next

The **Browse** table filters and sorts all recipes by title, category, time, or
portions. The **Import** tab converts a recipe found on the web into Gram
format and submits it to the cookbook.
